**Stable ID:** `DATA-04.02` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 04 Dataset identity, versions and relationships

Model versions, subsets, splits, file formats and size units so that distinct artifacts are never merged.

## Deliverables

- Version, subset and split model
- Format and size-unit vocabulary

## Canonical artifact paths

- `schemas/dataset-record.schema.json`
- `docs/TAXONOMY.md`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Version identity cites the publisher's own version marker or an immutable host revision

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An unversioned reference is flagged as ambiguous
- [ ] Each split belongs to exactly one version
- [ ] Validator rejects version and split ambiguity

## Non-goals

- Inferring version equivalence from file names

## Tasks and subtasks

- [ ] `DATA-04.02.T1` Model versions
  - [ ] `DATA-04.02.T1.S1` Define version and revision identity
  - [ ] `DATA-04.02.T1.S2` Define subset and config identity
  - [ ] `DATA-04.02.T1.S3` Define split identity and sizes
- [ ] `DATA-04.02.T2` Model formats
  - [ ] `DATA-04.02.T2.S1` Define the format vocabulary
  - [ ] `DATA-04.02.T2.S2` Define size units
  - [ ] `DATA-04.02.T2.S3` Add ambiguity checks
